choose.when: SELECT CASE WHEN o.path IS NULL THEN 'ADDED' WHEN n.path IS NULL THEN 'REMOVED' ELSE 'CHANGED' END AS "change" , COALESCE(n.path, o.path) AS "name" , COALESCE(n.file_type, o.file_type) AS "detail" , COALESCE(n.path, o.path) AS "path" FROM (SELECT * FROM analysis_file WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId}) n FULL JOIN (SELECT * FROM analysis_file WHERE revision_id = #{baseRevisionId}) o ON o.path = n.path WHERE o.path IS NULL OR n.path IS NULL OR o.checksum <> n.checksum

SELECT CASE WHEN o.symbol_id IS NULL THEN 'ADDED' ELSE 'REMOVED' END AS "change" , COALESCE(n.fqn, o.fqn) AS "name" , COALESCE(n.kind, o.kind) AS "detail" , f.path AS "path" FROM (SELECT * FROM analysis_symbol WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId}) n FULL JOIN (SELECT * FROM analysis_symbol WHERE revision_id = #{baseRevisionId}) o ON o.symbol_id = n.symbol_id LEFT JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = COALESCE(n.file_id, o.file_id) WHERE o.symbol_id IS NULL OR n.symbol_id IS NULL

SELECT CASE WHEN o.method_id IS NULL THEN 'ADDED' WHEN n.method_id IS NULL THEN 'REMOVED' ELSE 'CHANGED' END AS "change" , COALESCE(ns.fqn, os.fqn) || '#' || COALESCE(n.signature, o.signature) AS "name" , CASE WHEN n.method_id IS NOT NULL AND o.method_id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(o.return_type, '') || ' → ' || COALESCE(n.return_type, '') ELSE COALESCE(n.return_type, o.return_type) END AS "detail" , f.path AS "path" FROM (SELECT * FROM analysis_method WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND NOT is_synthetic) n FULL JOIN (SELECT * FROM analysis_method WHERE revision_id = #{baseRevisionId} AND NOT is_synthetic) o ON o.method_id = n.method_id LEFT JOIN analysis_symbol ns ON ns.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND ns.symbol_id = n.owner_symbol_id LEFT JOIN analysis_symbol os ON os.revision_id = #{baseRevisionId} AND os.symbol_id = o.owner_symbol_id LEFT JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = COALESCE(n.file_id, o.file_id) WHERE o.method_id IS NULL OR n.method_id IS NULL OR o.return_type IS DISTINCT FROM n.return_type OR o.visibility IS DISTINCT FROM n.visibility OR o.is_static <> n.is_static OR o.is_abstract <> n.is_abstract

SELECT CASE WHEN o.k IS NULL THEN 'ADDED' ELSE 'REMOVED' END AS "change" , COALESCE(n.label, o.label) AS "name" , COALESCE(n.handler, o.handler) AS "detail" , COALESCE(n.file_path, o.file_path) AS "path" FROM () n FULL JOIN () o ON o.k = n.k WHERE o.k IS NULL OR n.k IS NULL

SELECT CASE WHEN o.k IS NULL THEN 'ADDED' WHEN n.k IS NULL THEN 'REMOVED' ELSE 'CHANGED' END AS "change" , COALESCE(n.label, o.label) AS "name" , COALESCE(n.statement_type, o.statement_type) AS "detail" , COALESCE(n.file_path, o.file_path) AS "path" FROM () n FULL JOIN () o ON o.k = n.k WHERE o.k IS NULL OR n.k IS NULL OR o.body_hash <> n.body_hash

SELECT CASE WHEN o.k IS NULL THEN 'ADDED' ELSE 'REMOVED' END AS "change" , COALESCE(n.table_name, o.table_name) AS "name" , COALESCE(n.crud, o.crud) || ' ← ' || COALESCE(n.statement, o.statement) AS "detail" , COALESCE(n.file_path, o.file_path) AS "path" FROM () n FULL JOIN () o ON o.k = n.k WHERE o.k IS NULL OR n.k IS NULL
choose.otherwise:
SELECT CASE WHEN o.from_id IS NULL THEN 'ADDED' ELSE 'REMOVED' END AS "change" , fs.fqn || '#' || fm.signature AS "name" , '→ ' || ts.fqn || '#' || tm.signature AS "detail" , f.path AS "path" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT from_id, to_id FROM analysis_relation WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND relation_type = 'CALLS' AND to_id IS NOT NULL) n FULL JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT from_id, to_id FROM analysis_relation WHERE revision_id = #{baseRevisionId} AND relation_type = 'CALLS' AND to_id IS NOT NULL) o ON o.from_id = n.from_id AND o.to_id = n.to_id
JOIN LATERAL (SELECT m.* FROM analysis_method m WHERE m.method_id = COALESCE(n.from_id, o.from_id) AND m.revision_id IN (#{revisionId}, #{baseRevisionId}) ORDER BY m.revision_id DESC LIMIT 1) fm ON TRUE JOIN LATERAL (SELECT m.* FROM analysis_method m WHERE m.method_id = COALESCE(n.to_id, o.to_id) AND m.revision_id IN (#{revisionId}, #{baseRevisionId}) ORDER BY m.revision_id DESC LIMIT 1) tm ON TRUE JOIN analysis_symbol fs ON fs.revision_id = fm.revision_id AND fs.symbol_id = fm.owner_symbol_id JOIN analysis_symbol ts ON ts.revision_id = tm.revision_id AND ts.symbol_id = tm.owner_symbol_id LEFT JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = fm.file_id WHERE o.from_id IS NULL OR n.from_id IS NULL

mapper.sql: SELECT e.endpoint_type || '|' || COALESCE(e.http_method, '') || '|' || COALESCE(e.path, '') || '|' || COALESCE(e.method_id, e.symbol_id, '') AS k , e.endpoint_type || ' ' || COALESCE(e.http_method || ' ', '') || COALESCE(e.path, '') AS label , COALESCE(s.fqn || '#' || m.signature, s.fqn) AS handler , f.path AS file_path FROM analysis_endpoint e LEFT JOIN analysis_method m ON m.revision_id = e.revision_id AND m.method_id = e.method_id LEFT JOIN analysis_symbol s ON s.revision_id = e.revision_id AND s.symbol_id = COALESCE(m.owner_symbol_id, e.symbol_id) LEFT JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = e.file_id WHERE e.revision_id = #{${rev}}

SELECT f.path || '|' || COALESCE(mp.namespace, '') || '|' || mp.statement_id || '|' || (mp.statement_type = 'SQL_FRAGMENT') AS k , COALESCE(mp.namespace || '.', '') || mp.statement_id AS label , mp.statement_type , md5(COALESCE(mp.sql_body, '')) AS body_hash , f.path AS file_path FROM analysis_mapper mp JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = mp.file_id WHERE mp.revision_id = #{${rev}}

SELECT DISTINCT f.path || '|' || COALESCE(mp.namespace, '') || '|' || mp.statement_id || '|' || r.to_external || '|' || COALESCE(r.properties_json->>'crud', '') AS k , r.to_external AS table_name , COALESCE(r.properties_json->>'crud', '') AS crud , COALESCE(mp.namespace || '.', '') || mp.statement_id AS statement , f.path AS file_path FROM analysis_relation r JOIN analysis_mapper mp ON mp.revision_id = r.revision_id AND 'S' || mp.mapper_id = r.from_id JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = mp.file_id WHERE r.revision_id = #{${rev}} AND r.relation_type IN ('READS_TABLE', 'WRITES_TABLE')
mapper.select: SELECT x."change" AS "change", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM () x GROUP BY x."change"
SELECT x.* FROM () x ORDER BY x."change", x."name", x."detail" LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.revision_id FROM analysis_revision r JOIN analysis_revision p ON p.project_id = r.project_id AND p.revision_id < r.revision_id AND p.status = 'READY' WHERE r.revision_id = #{revisionId} ORDER BY p.revision_id DESC LIMIT 1
